title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 16. Notes with concern the escalation of conflict between Israel and Iran, and in the broader region, including Lebanon, Syria and Qatar; remains concerned about internal tensions in Lebanon and Syria; supports the contribution of the UN Interim Force In Lebanon (UNIFIL) to southern Lebanon and welcomes the extension of its mandate for one year; welcomes the conclusions of the ninth EU-Lebanon Association Council, in particular the willingness to further support the Lebanese security sector through the full use of EU tools, including the European Peace Facility and programmes under the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument – Global Europe, and to explore possible future CSDP engagement; underlines the need for progress on mutual confidence-building measures and the cessation of hostilities between Israel and Lebanon, including the disarmament of Hezbollah and other armed groups, as a prerequisite for regional stability; recalls that the majority of UNIFIL contingents come from EU Member States; condemns Iran’s persistent attempts to destabilise the region, either directly or through its proxies; highlights the need for the EU to support its partner, the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, also by increasing EPF funding for the protection of the Jordan-Syria border, which is being used by traffickers as a crossing point for arms and drug trafficking and has been weakened by the ongoing crisis in the Middle East;
